name: 伊能忠敬記念館
what: 伊能忠敬の生涯と業績を伝える博物館。国宝「伊能忠敬関係資料」を収蔵・展示する。開館は9時から16時30分、月曜休館（祝日の場合は翌平日）。
whatEn: A museum dedicated to the life and surveying work of Ino Tadataka, housing and exhibiting National Treasure materials from his survey of Japan. Open 9 am to 4:30 pm; closed Mondays (or the following weekday if Monday is a holiday).

name: 伊能忠敬旧宅
what: 伊能忠敬が17歳から49歳まで30年余りを過ごした国の史跡。小野川に面して店舗や書院、土蔵が残る。9時から16時30分、入館無料、年末年始のみ休館。
whatEn: A national historic site where Ino Tadataka lived for over thirty years from age 17 to 49, with its storefront, study and storehouse facing the Ono River. Open 9 am to 4:30 pm; free entry; closed only at New Year.

name: 水郷佐原山車会館
what: 八坂神社の境内にある、佐原の大祭の山車や大人形を展示する館。開館は9時から16時30分、月曜休館（祝日の場合は翌平日）。
whatEn: A museum in the grounds of Yasaka Shrine displaying the festival floats and large figures of the Sawara Grand Festival. Open 9 am to 4:30 pm; closed Mondays (or the following weekday if Monday is a holiday).

name: 香取神宮
what: 全国約400社の香取神社の総本社。授与所・御朱印受付は8時30分から17時まで。
whatEn: The head shrine of roughly four hundred Katori shrines across Japan. The amulet and goshuin office is open 8:30 am to 5 pm.
notice: 宝物館は改修工事のため長期休館中（2026年11月現在、再開日未定）。
noticeEn: The Treasure Hall is closed long-term for renovation (as of November 2026; reopening date undecided).
